description: Create a text node on the Figma canvas. Use width to fix the column width and enable text wrapping.

height.description: Fixed height in px — clips or scrolls content. Only meaningful when width is also set.

textAutoResize.description: Resize behaviour. HEIGHT (default when width set): fix width, grow height. NONE: fixed box. WIDTH_AND_HEIGHT: auto-size both (default).

width.description: Fixed column width in px — enables text wrapping. Height grows automatically unless height is also set.

name: create_text
